facts.anchor: Mom was due for her shift at the thrift store, so she couldn’t come with me to the viewing. I didn’t mind. I had a lot to think about as I drove into downtown, then across the bridge.
facts.fact: 看房路线：downtown → 过桥 → Victoria 的 condo 楼；她一路算账（若与 Zak 不成，她在这里还剩什么）。

facts.anchor: Old parts of me were wondering if maybe I should stay in Toronto. I was taking Roddie away from his new half-siblings. Being close to Mom would be nice, but what did I really have here in Vi
facts.fact: 房产经纪 Greg：silver fox 派、评估式打量（I sensed I was being assessed），以及一句 nice to put a face to a name。

facts.anchor: I pulled into the parking lot of the condo building and nosed into the visitor stall. As I left my SUV, a man popped out of the alcove entrance to the building.
facts.fact: Zak 的突袭：Zara 让他来打招呼，他整了头发却一脸 shaggy；Meg 心里只有 God, he was gorgeous。

facts.anchor: “Meg? Hi. I’m Greg. It’s nice to put a face to a name.” The realtor offered his hand to shake and held my gaze. I sensed I was being assessed and that he liked what he saw.
facts.fact: 他原本要宣布的坏消息（cool things off）与当场改口：「But I can't. I love you too much.」

facts.anchor: “Nice to meet you, too.” We’d only talked on the phone.
facts.fact: 她的坦白：I'm doing this for me（不为他）；她先说了 I love you——他把她抱起平视。

facts.anchor: He was taller than I expected and even more of a silver fox in person than his headshot. I didn’t hate what I saw, but—
facts.fact: 孩子的红线摊开：What if you want babies? / What if you can’t take how bad it gets with Dad?

facts.anchor: My heart leapt as I turned to see Zak striding toward us. He wore jeans and a T-shirt. His hair was tousled and shaggy, his beard scruffy and in need of cleaning up. God, he was gorgeous.
facts.fact: 他的 hereditary 自曝：You know it could be hereditary, right?——他把自己的遗传风险摊在桌上。

facts.anchor: I threw myself at him. “What are you doing here? I thought you couldn’t make it?”
facts.fact: 最终条款：Whatever this is, I'm in；不自己生孩子、做 Shelby 与 Roddie 的 sexy grandparents；Go sign whatever you need to sign. Then let's go do that again.
